caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, with a wide, rounded crown and a flared brim that extends downward along the back and sides. The bonnet is rendered in shades of brown, with the crown composed of darker brown, horizontally-quilted segments that create a textured, ridged effect. The inside edge of the brim has a lighter brown or beige lining that appears gathered or pleated. The brim itself is also brown, matching the main body of the bonnet, and is drawn to show the fabric's soft folds and shadows, indicating its three-dimensional form. The background is a light cream or off-white color, with no additional objects or details included. The overall composition centers the bonnet on the page, providing a clear view of its structure and material.
title: Shaker Woman's Bonnet
